prompt: Create a new employee onboarding presentation. Cover: company mission, team structure (Engineering, Product, Design, Sales — 4 teams), first week checklist (5 steps), tools we use (Slack, Linear, GitHub, Figma), and who to contact for what.

assertions.text: Loads Figtree and DM Sans fonts from Google Fonts
Uses navy (#1A1F5D or similar dark blue) as primary heading color
Uses reveal/fade-in animations with staggered delays
Implements spotlight hover on at least one component group
Mentions all 4 teams (Engineering, Product, Design, Sales) and all 4 tools (Slack, Linear, GitHub, Figma)
